summary_1line: Satyaki massacres Yavanas and allies, advances toward Arjuna through Kaurava ranks, and withstands a massive counterattack led by Duryodhana and other warriors.

image_candidates.scene_text: Satyaki in golden armor stands on his chariot like a second sun, loosing a storm of arrows into a sea of charging soldiers and elephants.
The battlefield lies carpeted with headless bodies and shattered helmets as Satyaki’s arrows rain down on fleeing Yavana warriors.
Surrounded by Duryodhana, Duhsasana, Sakuni, and many warriors, Satyaki calmly orders his charioteer to advance while drawing his radiant bow.
